isatvon_definition.i_instructions: Triggered by the Dify DMR's POST /tool/execute for skill_index 4 of Standard_BOM_Flow, after standardize_scrub_bom/standardize_quote_win/standardize_costing_sheet have populated the input tables. Action: clear any prior CBOM rows for this rfq_id (clear_cbom_rfq), detect the RFQ's volumes (queries.detect_volumes), materialize a QuoteWin tie-break selection view (queries.selected_quote_sql), then insert the CBOM structure with _qw pricing columns populated (queries.cbom_insert_sql) -- all inside one transaction. Check: the transaction commits only if no exception is raised; on any exception the whole transaction is rolled back. Bound: single attempt, no retry loop -- this is the FIRST reporting-stage tool, so unlike the other 5 reporting tools it does NOT require pre-existing cbom_db.cbom rows; it only requires input_db.scrub_bom_items rows to exist (raises ValueError otherwise). Business rule: regenerates ONLY the cbom table -- does not touch the 16 downstream reports.

fresh_state_parameters: input_db.scrub_bom_items rows for this rfq_id -- REQUIRED precondition; run_cbom raises ValueError if zero rows found
input_db.volume, input_db.batch, input_db.quote_win rows for this rfq_id (read during generation, not independently gated)
Whether cbom_db.cbom already has rows for this rfq_id (cleared unconditionally via clear_cbom_rfq before regenerating -- this tool is always a full regenerate, never incremental)

a_automation.action_step: BEGIN TRANSACTION; cbom_generator.clear_cbom_rfq(con, rfq_id); cbom_generator.generate_cbom(con, rfq_id) (detects volumes, builds the QuoteWin selection view, inserts CBOM rows); COMMIT on success, ROLLBACK on any exception.
a_automation.acceptance_check: No exception raised during generate_cbom -- the DB transaction's own COMMIT/ROLLBACK is the acceptance mechanism, not a separate post-hoc check.

t_tech_stack.action_tool: cbom (this tool itself, delegating to reporting_pipeline.run_cbom -> cbom_generator.generate_cbom/clear_cbom_rfq)
t_tech_stack.fixed_check_tool: None -- no independent validation MCP tool exists; the precondition check (input_db.scrub_bom_items row count) is inline SQL in reporting_pipeline.py itself.

v_variables.success_gate: generate_cbom() completes without raising -- transaction commits
v_variables.no_op_condition: None -- this tool always fully clears and regenerates cbom rows for the rfq_id on every call; there is no idempotent already-processed short-circuit like the intake tools have
v_variables.escalation_condition: None -- this tool never sets hitl:1 (confirmed: its MCP wrapper never includes a hitl key at all); a precondition failure (no scrub_bom_items rows) raises ValueError, which the MCP wrapper catches and returns as status:'failed', not as a hitl gate
v_variables.budget_limit: 300s MCP Jungle call_tool() timeout / 600s Dify HTTP node timeout -- same real values used platform-wide

json_schema.warnings: array of strings (e.g. noting rows with no resolved final price yet)

o_outcome.state_handoff_file: No dedicated append-only audit table exists. Real state handoff is: (1) the cbom_db.cbom rows themselves, (2) a single logger.info(...) line written to reporting_module's report_generation.log via logging_utils.logger. No PostHog event is fired for this specific tool (confirmed: mcp_server.py's cbom tool has no analytics_posthog_client.capture call, unlike generate_reports/export_reports).
